digest.component_or_area: rebar-janitor discovery phase - test oracle and contract verification
propositions: The rebar-janitor discovery phase lacks coverage for oracle strength (whether assertions can actually fail on contract violations) and contract-coverage gaps, despite these classes being documented in code-review-tests.md
Two production bugs escaped in Aug 2026 (0e1d-c698-c38d-4c3e, 9bb7-4430-1202-4d93) due to fail-open oracles and weak test assertions that did not detect contract violations
The verification phase incorrectly anchors test-only findings at prod_impact=none based on file location rather than on whether the test guards a production contract

Adding concern #12 requires updating the discovery schema sentence from 'eleven concerns' to 'twelve concerns', and a durable oracle (test_janitor_concern_schema.py) must prevent future drift between the concern list count and the schema statement

The portable fallback in references/patterns.md must define oracle-strength antipatterns independently for repos lacking code-review-tests.md, with concrete escape_input proofs required for every finding
